system.description: Unlike the indiscriminate Silence of Death, this technique lets you silence only the specific individuals or objects you choose. You exhale a thin mist of blood that clings to your chosen subjects. Spend two Blood Traits and make a Static Mental Challenge (retest Stealth) against a difficulty of seven Traits for each object or individual you want to silence, up to a maximum number of subjects equal to 3 plus your Stealth Ability Traits. Each subject must be within 20 yards of you. Larger objects count as more than one subject (a heavy machine gun counts as two, a car as three, a small aircraft as five); nothing larger than a private jet or an elephant can be silenced this way. Each subject is completely silenced for a number of minutes equal to your permanent Willpower — nothing it does generates sound, though secondary effects (like a bullet breaking the sound barrier) still do.
